import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Parse body_mass_g: strip commas, convert to float
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    # Drop rows where body_mass_g is out of valid range
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)].reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: coerce to numeric, set out-of-range to NaN
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    # Fix sex case variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return result.to_dict()
